capabilities.name: Extrude
capabilities.description: Sweep a validated planar profile into a solid.
capabilities.notes: Analytic volume asserted, not self-consistency.

capabilities.name: Boolean union
capabilities.description: Union two solids, counting the shared volume once.
capabilities.notes: 100 of 100 benchmark unions needed the coplanar retry nudge.

capabilities.name: Boolean intersection
capabilities.description: Intersection of two solids.
capabilities.notes: Verified on a 2x2x10 mm overlap (40 mm3).

capabilities.name: Boolean difference
capabilities.description: Subtract one solid from another.
evidence: crates/cad-kernel-truck/examples/corpus: difference_piercing_cut 84000 mm3 / 22400 mm2 (delta 0), difference_contained_void 184000 mm3 / 32800 mm2 (delta 0)
crates/cad-studio/tests/http_api.rs::a_cut_removes_the_analytic_volume_and_survives_save_reopen_and_undo (255 mm3 exact through save, reopen, undo and STL export)
capabilities.notes: Advertised and verified through the truck adapter. The earlier claim that difference returns a wrong solid (1053.3 mm3 for an 840 analytic cut) measured truck's *raw* output; that output is wrong only because the cavity walls are wound inward, and the adapter's weld + orientation repair corrects it, so the volume was never rebuilt wrong. Two defects remain and are stated: (1) operands with coincident faces need the coplanar retry, whose nudge leaves a 1.1e-4 mm membrane and a non-watertight tessellation (corpus fixture difference_coplanar_cut is a recorded known failure); (2) a difference that removes everything is refused rather than returned as a sliver. The application avoids (1) by building every cut tool with CUT_OVERSHOOT_MM of overshoot.

capabilities.name: Fillet and chamfer
capabilities.description: Round or bevel edges.
capabilities.notes: Present in SolidCraft's kernel (read from source); not exercised in this workspace because the kernel test suite was not run.

capabilities.name: Tessellation
capabilities.description: Convert a solid into a validated, closed triangle mesh.
capabilities.notes: Verified for planar boxes and for boolean results. Per-face vertices are welded and the winding is made consistent outward on the way out: before that repair a box cap was wound inward and the mesh reported 8 open edges. Each connected shell is then given the sign its nesting depth requires, so a cavity is wound inward and subtracts its volume instead of adding it — without that, a cut enclosing a void reported outer + cavity (216000 mm3 instead of 184000). Curved-surface tessellation was not measured.

capabilities.name: Binary STL export
capabilities.description: Write a validated triangle mesh as a binary STL file.
evidence: an independent Python parser read the written file: 12 triangles, volume 500.0000 mm3, 0 open edges
capabilities.notes: Written by cad-io; the CLI and studio are thin callers. STL has no unit field, so a document header must accompany it when units matter.

capabilities.name: Agent contract
capabilities.description: A versioned, self-describing declaration of what an agent is, what it accepts, what it produces and what it may do.
capabilities.notes: The contract version is a single integer. A contract that declares a different version is refused before it is stored, not half-interpreted.

capabilities.name: Agent runtime
capabilities.description: Registration, lifecycle enforcement, capability grants, budget enforcement and schema checking around agent calls.
capabilities.notes: An agent reaches ready only with a passing contract-test report and an owner decision covering every owner-gated permission it declares.

capabilities.name: Geometry operations agent
capabilities.description: Extrude, boolean, tessellate and measure solids through the shared kernel contract, inside the agent runtime.
capabilities.notes: Boolean difference is refused because the underlying adapter does not advertise it; the agent reports that rather than returning a wrong solid.

capabilities.name: Local parametric project persistence
capabilities.description: Local parametric project payload that saves atomically, reopens across schema versions, and survives a crash: an unsaved edit is kept in a recovery snapshot next to the file and offered on the next start, including when the file cannot be read.
capabilities.notes: Saves are atomic (temp file, fsync, rename) and the snapshot is a separate file, so an autosave never writes the project. A superseded snapshot is deleted and a corrupt one ignored. Named revisions are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Ordered feature graph with union join
capabilities.description: Ordered sketches and features with stable IDs; a feature may only consume earlier geometry, the history rebuilds sequentially through the kernel with a per-prefix cache, and a feature may start a body, join it, or cut it with a boolean.
evidence: engineering/quality/tests.json#t-cad-studio-m11d (980 mm3 joined volume over HTTP, save/reopen and STL parse-back)
capabilities.notes: Linear and single-body: a second new_body is refused, and cut is gated on a passing difference corpus. A failed feature is reported by ID and the last good mesh is kept. Each built prefix is cached under a hash of its resolved inputs, bounded at 32 entries.

capabilities.name: Local entitlement policy
capabilities.description: Evaluate local/cloud feature tier inclusion, quotas, overage behavior and idempotent payment lifecycle events.
capabilities.notes: Policy logic only. No billing provider or live subscription service exists; prices are hypotheses and tax is not modeled as revenue.

capabilities.name: Local-first CAD studio
capabilities.description: Open a project, edit named parameters and the sketch profile, place sketches, extrude as a new body or a join, see each feature's rebuild status, undo/redo, inspect faces, save atomically and export STL in a desktop browser session served from 127.0.0.1.
capabilities.notes: No accounts, cloud, collaboration or telemetry. The listener is loopback-only and every POST requires a same-origin Origin. It is one project per process, not a multi-user service. A feature that cannot rebuild is marked in the tree and blocks export.

capabilities.name: 3D viewport and face picking
capabilities.description: WebGL1 orbit/pan/zoom/fit viewport with shaded mesh, wireframe, grid, axes, sketch outline, and ray-triangle face picking.
evidence: browser exercise: WebGL context ready; 92-triangle circle mesh uploaded; clicking the viewport returned X -3.39, Y -3.65, Z 7.85 mm and normal (-0.609, -0.793, 0)
browser exercise: parameter and profile changes rebuilt and reframed the model without console or network errors
capabilities.notes: Exercised in Chromium through the harness. There is no pixel-level visual regression suite, and no performance claim for large meshes.

capabilities.name: Command palette
capabilities.description: Searchable, keyboard-driven palette over real document, view, profile, parameter and help commands.
evidence: browser exercise: Ctrl+K listed 19 connected commands; running “Profile: circle” changed the project profile and rebuilt 92 triangles
capabilities.notes: Every entry invokes the same API or UI function as its button; there are no placeholder commands.

capabilities.name: Rigid translation
capabilities.description: Move a solid by a delta without rotating it.
evidence: crates/cad-document/src/lib.rs CUT_OVERSHOOT_MM: a cut builds an overshooting tool with this
capabilities.notes: Added as a contract capability because an exact through-cut needs a tool that overshoots the body, and extrude always starts at z = 0, so a tool built for a body spanning z 0..h always shares a plane with it.

capabilities.name: Revolve
capabilities.description: Turn a validated planar profile a full revolution about one of its sketch axes, producing a solid of revolution.
evidence: engineering/quality/tests.json#t-cad-kernel-truck-m11d (analytic cylinder and annulus volumes, watertight meshes)
engineering/quality/tests.json#t-cad-studio-m11d (annulus over HTTP, save/reopen, watertight STL export)
capabilities.notes: Full turn only: a partial sweep is an open shell and the document carries bodies only, so it is refused with a reason. A profile that straddles the axis is refused rather than producing a self-intersecting solid. The adapter uses truck's `rsweep`.

capabilities.name: Release gate, licence policy and SBOM
capabilities.description: One committed command checks formatting, lints, tests, the analytic corpus, manifest validity, every dependency's licence, the SBOM and a live simulation, then packages and re-verifies a deployable bundle.
capabilities.notes: Runs offline. The licence policy fails closed on an unrecognised licence. CI wiring exists but has not run on a runner; signing, installers, an update channel and advisory scanning are outstanding.

capabilities.name: Token-gated LAN session sharing
capabilities.description: Expose one live studio session on the local network behind a 128-bit session token; the page shows the link, and every API call must present the token.
capabilities.notes: Opt-in only: the default bind is loopback with no token. A non-loopback bind always requires a token; the static page is served without one so the browser can present it. One document and one history are shared, so the last write wins; there is no account layer and the link dies with the process.
